lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.title: Reteach and varied practice: input output and notation

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: These two examples show the same idea in two different formats.

steps: Substitute x = 5 into the rule: f(5) = 3(5) + 4.

items.prompt: Given f(x) = 2x - 3, find the value of x for which f(x) = 11.

steps: Set the rule equal to the target output: 2x - 3 = 11.

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Work these with your teaching parent. Say the reason for each step out loud before you write it.

items.prompt:
Function A is given by f(x) = 2x. Function B is given by the table:
x: 5, 8
y: 2, 5
Which function has the greater rate of change?
choices: Cannot be determined from the given information.
They have the same rate of change.

items.prompt: Function A is given by f(x) = x - 1. Function B starts at 3 and increases by 1 each unit. Which function has the greater value when x = 2?
choices: The two functions have equal values at that input.
Cannot be determined without a graph.

items.prompt:
A table shows:
x: 1, 2, 3, 4
y: 0, 3, 8, 15
Is the relationship linear or nonlinear?
choices: cannot be determined from a table

items.prompt: Classify the equation y = x² + 7 as linear or nonlinear.
choices: cannot be determined from an equation

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: A function contains the points (-1, -10) and (0, -4). Write the function rule f(x) = mx + b.
A rental company charges a $98 base fee plus $8 per hour. Which function models the total cost f(x) for x hours?
A hiker climbs a steady, unchanging slope for the whole hike. Which description best matches the shape of the graph over time?
choices: increasing at a constant rate the whole time
decreasing at a constant rate the whole time

items.prompt:
A graph shows height over time.
From t = 0 to t = 1, height goes from 1 to 1.
From t = 1 to t = 3, height goes from 1 to 16.
From t = 3 to t = 8, height goes from 16 to 11.
Which interval shows the height constant?
Consider the relation {(-13, -10), (12, 10), (-2, 13), (-13, -2)}. Is this relation a function?
choices: Yes, this relation is a function.
It is a function only if every output is different.
No, this relation is not a function.
Cannot be determined from the given pairs.
